T: It's wonderful. You should be very proud.
D: An Amazon princess leaves her hidden island to stop a war she believes a god has started.
P: Serve dessert when Diana tastes ice cream for the first time in London.
S: the hidden island of the Amazons
Olives, fresh figs, feta drizzled with honey and thyme, warm pita and haloumi griddled until golden with a squeeze of lemon, all on one big platter.
Beef mince, diced potato and onion seasoned with plenty of pepper, folded into shortcrust half moons, crimped, egg washed, baked at 200C for 30 minutes. English mustard.
the village of Veld they free
Thick-cut fries double fried at 140C then 180C, salted, served in paper cones with mayonnaise.
M: the night the village celebrates and dances
Beef chuck browned, onions cooked slowly, dark beer, thyme, bay and a little mustard, braised at 160C for 3 hours. Frites.
Charlie, the sniper who sings at the piano
Smoked fish poached gently in milk and flaked, leek and potato softened in butter, the milk added, simmered until the potato breaks down, finished with cream and chives. Cullen skink.
W: she tells the vendor he should be very proud
Vanilla ice cream: cream, milk, yolks, sugar and vanilla cooked to 82C, chilled and churned, served in cones.
K: a toast in the freed village of Veld
A strong Belgian ale poured slowly into a stemmed glass, leaving a thick head.

s.note: the hidden island of the Amazons
s.how: Griddle 250g sliced haloumi until golden and squeeze lemon over. Drizzle 150g feta with honey and thyme. Arrange on a big platter with olives, 4 halved figs and 4 warm pita breads.

Mix 300g beef mince with a diced potato and onion and plenty of pepper. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust into rounds, fill and fold into half moons. Crimp, egg wash and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with English mustard.

m.note: the night the village celebrates and dances
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Cook 3 sliced onions slowly, add 375ml dark beer, thyme, bay and 1 tbsp Dijon. Braise at 160C for 3 hours. Fry 1kg potatoes into frites, at 140C then 180C, and serve alongside.

w.note: she tells the vendor he should be very proud
w.how: Warm 400ml cream and 300ml milk with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 5 yolks with 120g sugar, pour over and cook to 82C. Chill overnight and churn. Scoop into 4 waffle cones and eat it fast, like it is the first ice cream ever.

d.note: a toast in the freed village of Veld
d.how: Chill four 330ml bottles of strong Belgian ale lightly. Pour slowly into stemmed glasses, leaving a thick head. Sip it, it's stronger than it looks.
